Sam (RevRec): Quick flag for close  a set of "WELCOME-CREDIT" promos were booked to discounts instead of deferred revenue. Need JE rec and whether to treat as prior period.
Ari (Billing): Which invoices/SKUs?
Sam (RevRec): SKU=WELCOME-CREDIT. Affected: INV-16011 (Fjord) $28,500, INV-16018 (Pillar) $4,200, INV-16025 (Arcane) $2,100. Term = 12 months, billing applied as one-off discount.
Marta (Accounting): Materiality: Fjord >25k so needs head finance sign-off. Propose reclass remaining balances as of 5/31.
Sam (RevRec): Remaining amortizable as of 5/31: Fjord $26,125 (11/12), Pillar $3,850, Arcane $1,925. Link to export: https://drive.google.com/file/d/welcome-credits-export (view).
Marta (Accounting): Draft JE for Fjord:
DR 4100 Sales Discounts 26,125
CR 2390 Deferred Revenue - Promotions 26,125
Memo: Reclass WELCOME-CREDIT remaining balance for INV-16011; attach amort schedule.
Victor (Controller): For Fjord treat as prior period correction given size and that recognition hit prior month. Need Nadia sign-off. For the others, post normal correcting entries.
audit-bot: Reminder: PPC >$20k requires disclosure in footnotes.
Nadia (Head Finance): Approved PPC treatment for Fjord. Marta please post JE and label "PPC - promo reclass". Also include one-line audit rationale.
Marta (Accounting): Draft audit rationale: "WELCOME-CREDIT represents consideration for future access and should be recognized ratably over the term; initial classification as immediate discount was incorrect." Posting JE now and will update revenue rollforward.
Ari (Billing): I'll add a validation to map WELCOME-CREDIT SKUs to GL 2390 and add a unit test. Opening ticket BC-5011.
Victor (Controller): Action items: 1) Marta post JEs and update rollforward; 2) Ari implement billing validation; 3) Sam attach CSV and coordinate tax if needed. Deadline EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Accounting): JE posted NS-JE-600121 (Fjord PPC) and two correcting entries for Pillar/Arcane. Memos include invoice refs and export link. Circulating updated close pack.
